text: Entry 863 sets cryptoChanged after successful OpenPGP attachment decryption, including DECRYPTION_OKAY with an empty result. MessageHeaderProcessor uses this flag after decrypt: a false flag changes the classification back to none and can return the original raw message. A successful changed tree is serialized and parsed again for API output. The attachment test checks the decrypted filename, 14-byte size and Unicorn-Party content, rather than only a successful status. Manual state naming proposal: keep hasEncryptedParts, cryptoChanged, decryptFailure and decryptionStatus distinct; they describe detection, mutation, failure and the exposed result. Updating body data without the corresponding mutation flag is incomplete at this boundary.
title: A transformed MIME body must mark the result as changed before API serialization
